committee.sub: Morning brief · Monday 2 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Paid spend rose to A$139.58 from A$122.11 over the last 7 days while clicks slipped to 16 from 18, pushing CPC up to A$8.72. No conversions recorded in that window.

The landing-page test has reached 77 raw paid clicks, past the 75-click checkpoint, with A$526.86 spent and only A$18.95 of the A$600 credit left ex-GST. These are raw click figures only, the relevant and qualified counts live in Chris's test log.

Ask_cta_click has fired 18 times against 77 raw clicks since the test started. The page has been frozen since click 25, so no further headline or CTA changes should be made unless something is broken.

Organic Search sessions climbed to 11 from 5, still the only trustworthy unpaid signal. Search Console (data through 30 Oct, so two days behind yesterday) shows just 5 clicks from 192 impressions, with 'kontrol ai' ranking first for a single click. AI Assistant sessions sat at zero against 2 the prior week, likely undercounted into Direct rather than genuinely absent.

actions.text: Raw paid clicks on the test have hit 77, past the 75-click checkpoint. Check the test log now: if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries, the red flag applies.

Credit remaining has dropped to A$18.95 ex-GST, under the A$30 threshold. Apply the pause rule: keep paid search running only if cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still outstanding, action this when ready.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success. These need updating to the current site stats.
